Interpretation: There are three houses. Total number of brick boxes needed is 250. Let the number of boxes needed for house 1 be A, house 2 be B, house 3 be C. Given: house 1 needs half of house 2: A = (1/2) B, i.e., B = 2A. Also, house 3 needs double house 1: C = 2A. So we have A + B + C = 250. Substitute B = 2A, C = 2A. So A + 2A + 2A = 250 => 5A = 250 => A = 50. Then C = 2A = 100. So house 3 needs 100 boxes.

Thus answer: 100.
